programmes.d: As Mark's graduation approaches, he considers his relationship with his father.
Jackie faces problems at the Lunch Box and must take advice from an unexpected guest.
Becky introduces Tyler to Beverly Rose, but she is skeptical of Tyler’s approach.
Bev experiences moments of clarity and reflection and asks Jackie to spend the day together in Chicago.
Mark adjusts to his first day of college as a commuter student.
Darlene crashes Mark’s college trivia night to prove how smart she is.
Darlene urges Ben to make some male friends as he feels anxious about turning 50.
The hardware store suffers a smash and grab and Dan and Jackie hold one of the culprits.
Darlene seeks to be manager of food services at Mark’s college after feeling they could use some organization.
The Conners relish national cheeseball day. Harris falls behind in her work at the Lunch Box.
Dan is asked to write an article for a Hardware magazine, making Ben miss his days as a writer.
A fire at Ben’s hardware store causes a major setback for the family.
Dan achieves a major financial milestone, reconsidering his belief in the ‘Conners curse.’
Mark takes on odd jobs, determined to find a way to pay for school.
A sudden turn of events forces the Conners to face their daily struggles in a way they never have before.
Darlene’s in for a surprise when David introduces his girlfriend, Blue, at a parent-teacher conference.
It's Halloween, and a school email banning certain costumes, including Mark's, sets off a huge argument.
Geena learns D.J. hasn't been taking Mary to church while she's been away, so she insists they go as a family.
A family member drops a life-changing bombshell; Dan suspects Becky might have resumed drinking.
With Mark and Mary's help, Jackie convinces Dan to build a chicken coop so the family can eat organic eggs.
Dan questions Peter's motives when he learns about the pricey gift Jackie purchased for her unemployed beau.
When Becky helps Harris keep a secret from Darlene, it causes a split between the two sisters.
Dan gets injured covering D.J.'s vending machine route, but choosing to sue could lead to D.J. getting fired.
When Ben offers Mark free piano lessons, Darlene thinks it’s a way to test his parenting skills.
As Darlene grapples with a life-altering offer, a conversation with David turns her world more upside-down.
After Emilio's deported, Jackie steps up and creates a birth plan for Becky.
Darlene struggles to decide between David and Ben; Becky begins to doubt herself as a mom.
Harris is forced to confront Darlene about her lifestyle; Becky’s overwhelmed by the costs of raising a baby.
Becky applies for a bartending job at Casita Bonita; Dan is concerned it could worsen her drinking.
At Halloween, Jackie learns a shocking secret while trying to reopen the Lunch Box.
Jackie and Becky pitch Darlene their business plan hoping to get the Lunch Box reopened.
Chaos ensues when Dan finally gets the whole family together for Thanksgiving; Harris makes an unexpected move
Jackie’s faced with a tough decision that brings the family and community together.
Dan is disappointed when everyone but Becky forgets about his birthday; Darlene faces another issue.
The Conners struggle to accept Becky's new boyfriend, a big Packers fan.
Darlene’s thrilled when Harris gets into Central Illinois State, but she may have other plans.
The Conners share their opinions on voting; Louise gets an offer that could take her away from Lanford.
Dan avoids coping with a death, only to be faced with it head-on; Ben and Darlene address his baby fever.
Dan begins to bond with his younger half-brother but is angry their dad paid for Ed Jr.'s college education.
Darlene gets a job at Price Warehouse; Ben shaves his beard to look more clean-cut to advertisers.
Newly unemployed Harris moves back into the house; the entire Conner family contemplate tattoos.
Back from Arizona, Bev announces she wants to use her money to spread joy; she offers to pay Mark's tuition.
Dan’s ready to share his feelings with Louise; Darlene realizes how badly she wants a baby.
Dan and Louise take their relationship to the next level; Darlene spends the night in jail.
Darlene and Ben go apartment hunting; Jackie and Becky take Beverly Rose to Mexico to meet her father.
The Conners must deal with the pandemic; The Lunch Box closes for everything but takeout and delivery.
Mary’s crushed when the city cancels Halloween, so the family tries to create an unforgettable experience.
Darlene isolates herself from her co-workers, making them think she’s an elite snob.
It's Beverly Rose's first birthday, but Becky and Emilio disagree on the kind of celebration she should have.
Darlene's friendship with a manager at Wellman Plastics lands her in an awkward situation.
Harris' job is in jeopardy after joining a protest she believes in; Jackie makes a visit to Wellman Plastics.
Ben's mom arrives after an unexpected death and unveils shocking information from the past.
Harris brings home her new friend, Josh, leaving the family questioning his intentions.
Darlene earns a promotion at Wellman Plastics, while Ben decides on a new career path.
Chuck's purchase of a boat creates problems; Darlene hires an assistant at work who is anything but helpful.
Darlene starts to feel the pressures of her new job; Dan attempts to help Ben out at the hardware store.
Mark’s sure he has COVID; Becky and Harris team up to confront Josh who’s been 'ghosting' Harris.
